Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about your 3-Day Pass.

Are there any hidden fees or credit cards required for the trial?

No. We don't ask for a credit card. The trial pass is 100% free and without obligation. We want you to experience our gym first.

Does the 3-day pass have to be used on consecutive days?

We recommend using it within a 7-day period so you can experience different class layouts and coaching styles. We are highly flexible.

Can I attend any class style with my pass?

Yes! You can attend any of our scheduled strength, conditioning, or barbell classes during your 3-day trial period.
